result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign, and Adobe Acrobat Sign** are the three e-signature platforms I'd shortlist.

However, the best choice depends on whether you simply need customers to sign contracts or want a more complete system for sending quotes, managing proposals, and tracking signed agreements.

Here’s how I'd compare the leading options for a small business.

## Best e-signature software compared

| Software | Best for | My assessment |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Dropbox Sign** | Everyday contracts and agreements | Best for simplicity |
| **DocuSign** | Professional business contracts | Best all-rounder |
| **PandaDoc** | Quotes, proposals and sales contracts | Best all-in-one |
| **Adobe Acrobat Sign** | PDF-heavy businesses | Best for PDF workflows |
| **Zoho Sign** | Budget-conscious small teams | Best if you use Zoho |


### My top three

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign — Best for simplicity**

- Very easy to send documents for signing.
- Reusable templates and signing reminders.
- Good integration with Dropbox and other business tools.
- Ideal for client agreements, NDAs and service contracts.

Best if you want signing without unnecessary complexity.

[Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign — Best all-rounder**

- Widely recognised by businesses and customers.
- Strong audit trails and document tracking.
- Templates, automated reminders and signing workflows.
- Extensive integrations.

My choice if professionalism, reliability and scalability are priorities.

[DocuSign Australia](https://www.docusign.com/en-au)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc — Best for sales and proposals**

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Add pricing tables and product information.
- Send documents for electronic signing.
- Track when customers open and sign documents.

Best if you want more than just an electronic signature.

[PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

## Indicative pricing

For an Australian small business, here are some useful pricing reference points\:

| Software | Pricing reference |
|--------|--------|
| DocuSign Personal | A\$15/month |
| DocuSign Standard | A\$37/user/month |
| DocuSign Business Pro | A\$59/user/month |
| Adobe Acrobat Standard for teams | A\$26.99/licence/month |
| Adobe Acrobat Pro for teams | A\$37.99/licence/month |


DocuSign pricing is from its Australian pricing page; Adobe prices include GST. Check current Dropbox Sign and PandaDoc Australian checkout prices before committing. [ecom.docusign.com](https://ecom.docusign.com/en-AU/plans-and-pricing/esignature?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.adobe.com](https://www.adobe.com/au/acrobat/business/pricing-plans.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.pandadoc.com](https://www.pandadoc.com/blog/best-electronic-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Important for Australian businesses

Electronic signatures are generally recognised under Australia's Electronic Transactions Act 1999 and corresponding state and territory legislation.

However, not every document can be signed electronically. Certain deeds, witnessing requirements and government documents have additional rules. [www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions/electronic-signatures?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ags.gov.au](https://www.ags.gov.au/publications/legal-briefing/lb-20230904?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'd prioritise\:

- A downloadable signed PDF.
- A timestamped audit trail.
- Signer identity verification.
- Secure document storage.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Clear evidence of who signed and when.

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a small Australian business\:

- **Zoho Sign** for affordability and Australian business integration. Its Australian pricing starts at A\$10/user/month, billed annually. [See Zoho Sign](https://www.zoho.com/en-au/sign/)\.
- **Dropbox Sign** for straightforward signing and unlimited signature requests on paid plans. [See Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/products/dropbox-sign/pricing)\.
- **DocuSign** for a more established, professional signing workflow. [See DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/en-au)\.

## One question to narrow it down

**What type of small business will be using the software?**

**1\. Business type**

**2\. How many documents need signing monthly?**

---

**3\. How many people will send documents?**

---

**4\. What do you need it to do?**

I can then narrow it down to the best one or two platforms rather than having you pay for features your business doesn't need.

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
